evidenceRules.missing: An authored capability or dedicated animation/script is absent; a generic rendering fallback may still draw successfully.
evidenceRules.adaptation: An authored runtime sequence, generated bitmap, reused pose, transformed static layer or procedural effect. Its existence does not prove source fidelity.
evidenceRules.verified: Requires independently retained source reference, frame/scene comparison and explicit validation. No such certification is inferred from a name, profile, bitmap, or passing tests.
evidenceRules.bitmapEvidence: Binding analysis below inspects routing metadata only. Exact repeated RGBA cells are measured separately by auditCombatCharacterAnimations.mjs.

abilities.heuristicNote: The original broad Guard suffix includes 118 concrete defense names requiring review, not 118 confirmed generic actions.
abilities.strictDefinition: simple/secondary: original placeholder expressions; defense: Signature Guard|defensive action or exact hero.name + " Guard".

entries.sourceReference: Bastion’s beacon defines a safe route: deployment, alignment and protective planes, never an explosion.

entries.key: Nexus de Convergence::Drone de Suture::Drone de Suture
entries.sourceReference: Loom’s drone maintains an ally’s signature: hover, medical link, stabilization and return to the caller.

entries.key: Nexus de Convergence::Reflet Non Remplace::Reflet Non Remplace
entries.sourceReference: Tessera manifests a possible reflection without replacing a person: a mirrored arrival and refracted proof, then dissolution.

entries.key: Nexus de Convergence::Sonde de Retour::Sonde de Retour
entries.sourceReference: Nadir’s probe verifies a route in both directions: outbound scan, measured contact and a visible retraced return.
Halo Pelican gunship support: heavy approach, undercarriage firing pass and continued flight out of the arena.
Dog’s physical assistance uses a robot leap and grounded force, followed by a bounding retreat; no energy detonation.
Portal sentry: vertical placement, visible red targeting line, a ballistic burst and folding withdrawal.
PAYDAY’s deployable sentry is placed on the floor, aims mechanically and fires bullets; it does not walk or cast a beam.
The existing page deployment is represented by placed pages, paper motion and camera-static interference, without a fire or magic blast.
BFG-9000: capacitor charge, one traveling plasma sphere and branching green energy arcs; a single gameplay impact remains authoritative.
May’s Great Yamada Attack brings the whale across the scene in an arcing passage with a water surge, then carries it out.
Final Fantasy VII Hellfire: Ifrit arrives, gathers fire and sends a ground-reaching flame wave into the opposing formation.
Final Fantasy VII Diamond Dust: Shiva gathers cold, encases targets in ice and shatters the ice before disappearing.
Final Fantasy VII Megaflare: Bahamut descends above the battlefield, charges at its mouth and releases the charged ray into the targets.

entries.key: Sonic::Tails et le Tornado::Tornado Machine Gun
entries.sourceReference: Sonic Adventure’s Tornado: a banked airplane approach, machine-gun pass and rising departure, without a teleporting ground entrance.
Star Platinum manifests by Jotaro, closes to punch range, performs a visible fist barrage and withdraws to the caller.

entries.key: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure::Hermit Purple::Hermit Purple — Hamon
entries.sourceReference: Hermit Purple grows from Joseph as thorny purple vines; a gold Hamon pulse travels along the vine and retracts with it.
Gold Experience manifests beside Giorno, advances to its selected target, punches in a compact barrage and returns.
Imani’s project-owned Ghostline uprising spreads coordinated drone/signal links; its technology is not a ghost-shaped magical explosion.

entries.key: The Aether Crown::Mutinerie des Cieux::Mutinerie des Cieux
entries.sourceReference: Elara’s project-owned corsair command brings airborne allied craft along an advancing sky route with coordinated deck fire.
Bram Quill’s autonomous valve drone hovers, builds pressure and vents directed steam, then returns without exploding.

entries.key: Meridian Clockwork::Faucon à Ressort::Faucon à Ressort
entries.sourceReference: Lio’s spring-driven mechanical falcon winds up, dives along a clockwork arc and visibly homes back toward its operator.

entries.key: Aegea: War of the Moirai::Forge des Cent Boucliers::Forge des Cent Boucliers
entries.sourceReference: Doros’s project-owned forge constructs a bronze shield formation: assembling plates, a closing line and orderly withdrawal.

entries.key: Tawantinsuyu: The Split Sun::Message des Quatre Quartiers::Message des Quatre Quartiers
entries.sourceReference: Killa Mayu’s four-quarter message is a courier relay with linked route points and traveling signals, not an explosive summoned army.

entries.key: Yomi no Kage::Parade Nocturne Réconciliée::Parade Nocturne Réconciliée
entries.sourceReference: Daichi’s reconciled tsukumogami take a ground procession route with lantern-like markers before passing out of the scene.

entries.key: Mandate of Nine Heavens::Pas de l’Ancêtre::Pas de l’Ancêtre
entries.sourceReference: Mei Zhen’s ancestor conveys a message without becoming a soldier: gentle manifestation, guiding threads and a dissolving return.

entries.key: Ilyr Concordat::Chœur Nym Non Unanime::Chœur Nym Non Unanime
entries.sourceReference: Ixo-9’s distributed Nym collective coordinates distinct node voices through linked signal waves, not an indiscriminate explosion.
Parasoul’s Inferno Brigade calls physical Black Egret support: a ground convoy, coordinated ballistic fire and departure.
